# Overload-aware remote targeting and read-preference fallback

# Overload-aware remote targeting and read-preference fallback — concept pack (small)

> Source-anchored research for Overload-aware remote targeting and read-preference fallback. Run status: COMPLETED.

<!-- generated by llms-concept-abstractor v1.4.1 · generated 2026-10-29 · budgeted to ≈8000 tokens; the full catalogue is llms-full.txt -->

## How it works

- [statement] Overload retargeting is opt-in because primaryPreferred can select secondaries more often and expose applications to stale reads; secondaryPreferred can send reads to the primary more often. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-09-20) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-121740 · keywords: Overload-aware remote targeting and read-preference fallback · also: https://github.com/mongodb/specifications/blob/master/source/client-backpressure/client-backpressure.md, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/read-preference.md
- [statement] A PyMongo overload-retargeting test raced because secondaries were not necessarily discovered before the operation. Tests expecting a different replica-set target must establish discovery first. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-04-15) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/PYTHON-5798
- [statement] When enabled, mongos can retry a primaryPreferred read on an eligible secondary after a retryable SystemOverloadedError from the primary, even if the primary remains reachable. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/parameters.md · keywords: Overload-aware remote targeting and read-preference fallback · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/read-preference.md
- [statement] When enabled, mongos can retry a secondaryPreferred read on the primary when secondaries indicate overload. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/parameters.md · keywords: Overload-aware remote targeting and read-preference fallback · also: https://github.com/mongodb/specifications/blob/master/source/client-backpressure/client-backpressure.md
- [statement] With the server flag disabled, retries do not avoid members merely because they signaled overload and may repeatedly target such a member. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/parameters.md

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] Secondary replication is asynchronous, so increased secondary routing can expose reads to replication lag; enabling overload fallback does not remove the underlying staleness risk. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/read-preference.md · keywords: Overload-aware remote targeting and read-preference fallback · also: https://www.percona.com/sites/default/files/ple19-slides/day2-am/maintenance-for-mongodb-replica-sets.pdf, https://github.com/mongodb/specifications/blob/master/source/client-backpressure/client-backpressure.md

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] MongoDB 8.3 also introduced retry/backoff parameters for internal server-side clients between mongos and mongod; these accompany overload retargeting but control retry pacing rather than which member is preferred. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/release-notes/8.3.md

## Facts and statements

- [statement] MongoDB 8.3 introduced overloadAwareServerSelectionEnabled to opt into avoiding members that recently returned SystemOverloadedError during retries targeting other servers in the cluster. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/release-notes/8.3.md · keywords: Overload-aware remote targeting and read-preference fallback · also: https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-121740
- [statement] With overloadAwareServerSelectionEnabled=true, a router retrying a primary read that received a retryable SystemOverloadedError may choose an eligible secondary; the read-preference documentation limits this behavior to modes that can select multiple servers. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/read-preference.md
- [statement] Driver enableOverloadRetargeting and server overloadAwareServerSelectionEnabled are separate controls. The driver specification says sharded clients already retarget across mongos instances on retryable errors regardless of that driver setting; mongos separately controls retargeting within shards. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-27) — https://github.com/mongodb/specifications/blob/master/source/client-backpressure/client-backpressure.md · keywords: Overload-aware remote targeting and read-preference fallback · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/parameters.md, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/release-notes/8.3.md, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/read-preference.md
- [statement] SystemOverloadedError identifies overload but does not by itself establish safe retryability. RetryableError provides the explicit safe-retry signal; overload retries should apply backoff with jitter. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-27) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/overload-errors/ · keywords: Overload-aware remote targeting and read-preference fallback · also: https://github.com/mongodb/specifications/blob/master/source/client-backpressure/client-backpressure.md
- [statement] The client overload policy makes enableOverloadRetargeting an opt-in setting, separate from maxAdaptiveRetries; the C driver release notes expose both URI options. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-27) — https://github.com/mongodb/specifications/blob/master/source/client-backpressure/client-backpressure.md · keywords: Overload-aware remote targeting and read-preference fallback · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo-c-driver/blob/master/NEWS
- [statement] MongoDB 8.3 introduced overloadAwareServerSelectionEnabled. Its read-preference documentation states that this server control is disabled by default. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/parameters.md · keywords: Overload-aware remote targeting and read-preference fallback · also: https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-121740, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/release-notes/8.3.md, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/read-preference.md
- [statement] The server parameter governs overload-induced remote retries, including mongos requests to shard members and mongod remote reads during aggregation. It is not a general balancing policy for initial reads. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/parameters.md · keywords: Overload-aware remote targeting and read-preference fallback · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/read-preference.md
- [statement] Alibaba Cloud documents the flag for ApsaraDB for MongoDB 8.3, but its wording that a client automatically retries against a different node is broader than MongoDB's documented server-internal, retry-eligible scope. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-27) — https://help.aliyun.com/en/mongodb/product-overview/features-of-mongodb-8-3 · keywords: Overload-aware remote targeting and read-preference fallback · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/parameters.md
